decisions.reason: As a core extension of authentication and secure communication, it still fits the firm's strategic direction, but after several years and no visible recent emphasis its results are likely judged more strictly against aspiration levels.

Mobile signing remains close to the firm's secure identity and contract-signing path, so management would usually retain it, though limited visibility suggests it may have become a marginal or integrated offering if performance only meets aspirations weakly.

This more niche communication tool is the most likely to fall below aspiration levels after an extended trial, and boundedly rational management would reallocate its resources to stronger core and new development opportunities.

A compliance-focused security suite matches the firm's capabilities and regulated customer base well, so even with portfolio rationalization it is more likely to be retained unless its specific market traction has clearly disappointed.
